fusions.name: Sly Pop
fusions.desc: Fires a quick round that deals 4 damage, with 50% more critical chance against an unwounded target and a 15% chance to turn the target against its allies for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Blank Charge
fusions.desc: A blank charge goes off around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 0.8 seconds, with a 50% chance each to turn against its allies for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gone to Ground
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds and you move 15% faster. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you fire.

fusions.name: Cheap Trick
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
